v44 FINAL training set — assembled, awaiting review

120,390 training pairs (val 1,887 held out). Chosen = GT points rendered with som_marks_v2; rejected = a real Molmo2-4B rollout answer judged wrong under the official rule for its arena, after noise filtering: points arenas re-judged with SAM2∪SAM3 instance masks (PointingEval semantics), GUI arenas adjudicated by a gpt-5.6-luna → gpt-5.6-sol cascade that never sees the GT box (both must say off_target; measured purity 93-96%). More-wins vs fewer-wins balanced 1:1 by discard; v43 synthetic placement pairs mixed in as the supplement.
